Whether you’re planning an epic thru-hike, cycling, traveling, a 5-day trek in the mountains, or a quick weekend jaunt in the woods, having a 40L trekking backpack is the key. With a stylish look, this packable go-anywhere pack for super-hiker who make every gram count. This is a cushy light weight pack with excellent all-round value. The backpack strikes an exceptional balance between weight, weather resistance, and durability to carry heavier loads comfortably, and won’t break the bank either. It showcases some features of the contoured-mesh back panel, which contours the back pleasantly and increases ventilation on the trial. Therefore, it provides superb breathability and great body-to-back panel contact.

This companion has multiple large capacity to carry your gears, cell phones, clothes on-the-go, and two external water reservoir sleeve which fits water reservoirs with a volume of 3 liters for easy hydration while hiking. The pack also come with some convenient extras like hip belt pockets, they are big enough for cell phone, camera, and other accessories which you want within easy reach, lid pocket to store quick-grab gear. The trekking pole attachment system is interesting while it allows you to attach the poles without taking the backpack off.

The real added value of the 40L trekking backpack is its adjustability. The fully-adjustable hip belt padding and top lid are both removable. The bag materials are sturdy, and the hip belt is substantially padded. With 3lbs weights, and adequate compartment- it’s ideally best for hikers and travelers who know how to pack smart.

UMI 3D Windows films are very easy to use. The beautiful privacy glass stickers are a magic to your eyes. Because of their versatility, you can paste films on your doors and windows to give a brilliant look to all of your rooms, office or store.

While you will enjoy the privacy of these windows films, you will also be able to see light. In fact, while you are inside your house, you will be able to see a shape of someone knocking on your door. This is why these frosted opaque obscure covering films are great for privacy and beauty.

To apply the films on your windows, you need to clean your glass first and then paste the peeled, smooth side of the films onto them. The easy-to-apply films can be pasted, removed and reused as often as you wish without leaving any stain on the windows. Then, choose your favorite color of Anti UV shinny pebble windows film , which will block out the sunrays from damaging your furniture. 

Tips for Customers:

1.>The adhesive performance may not be good in winter. Solution:use hair dryer or soak in warm water to make it soft before mounting,( heat resistance is under 176℉)

2.>Only Fit for smooth surface without any dust or fiber.

3.>Do not use on outside window or windows with cracks.

4.>Tear off the back-covering film before using.

5.>The color only shows when light comes through or reflects

COLOR DIFFERENCE:

Window films look different with different backgrounds or under different lights.

So please understand there would be color difference between photos and real products.

Package includes: 6pcs/pack Makeup Blender Set
1. Orange oval-shaped sponge*2
2. Black teardrop-shaped sponge*2
3. Pink pear-shaped sponge*2
All made from non-latex and non-allergic material, commonly used for all kinds of cosmetics, also perform well for someone who has sensitive skin.

Soft-feeling and smooth finish, always give you a gorgeous and seamless makeup application.
Washable and reusable beauty makeup blenders, versatile shapes/colors give you a happy mood, meet all your makeup needs.

Take Care for "Common Issues"
Wet the sponge and squeeze out excess water before applying liquid foundation.
DO NOT apply the foundation directly to the sponge! Instead, dot foundation over your face and then use the sponge to blend.
DO NOT apply in a circular motion. Lightly tap or push it into your face for an amazing & smooth finish.

How to Use---Wet & Dry
Use the flat round( orange oval) or wide bottom (pink pear and a black teardrop) for the larger areas of your face, such as your forehead, cheeks, and chin.
Use the pointy end to get into the hard-to-reach area, such as under the eyes, mouth, nose, etc.
Dry use for the application of powder, blusher, highlight, shading, etc.
Wet use for milky or creamy products, such as foundation, BB, lotion, concealer, etc. Squeeze out excess water, using a paper towel if necessary.

How To Clean
1. Dampen the dirty sponge slightly.
2. Dab a small amount of shampoo or Blender Cleanser. Gently massage & press it.
3. Rinse & squeeze it. Keep going until no stains.
4. Air-dry it.

Replace every 3 months for the best bounce.
